method: The right-hand 80 pi sweep mirrored: the same 1x1 radial square on a left-hand helix r=10, pitch=3, turns=4. V = A * 2 pi xbar * turns = 1 * 2 pi * 10 * 4 = 80 pi; the left chirality mirrors the solid through the y=0 plane, so area/bbox match the right-hand case and the centroid sits on the axis.
